editorial:
Imagine being a supermodel couple invited on a fancy cruise with the richest people on earth. At first, everything looks perfect for your Instagram feed, but things go south quickly. You get to see how awkward it is when rich people try to be nice to those working for them. The vibe starts as a funny look at fame and money, but it quickly turns into a wild ride when the ship hits trouble. It is basically a big joke about how people act when they have everything versus when they have nothing.

You will love how the power shifts once the survivors end up on a beach. The acting is great, especially the parts where the characters realize their money is useless in the wild. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the crazy scenes make up for it. If you want a movie that makes you laugh at wealthy people, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After the crash, Abigail, the cleaning lady, becomes the leader because she is the only one who knows how to fish and make fire. The rich people try to trick her to get power back. In the final scene, Abigail finds a way to escape the island alone. She tells the others she is going to find help, but she actually just leaves them behind to save herself, finally winning the game of power.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedy and seeing rich people lose their cool.
